SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM ( SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(FILE_EXTSN) IN ('mp4', 'avi', 'mpeg') THEN 'MEDIA' WHEN LOWER(FILE_EXTSN) IN ('jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'png', 'bmp') THEN 'IMAGE' WHEN LOWER(FILE_EXTSN) IN ('mp3', 'wav', 'mid') THEN 'MUSIC' END AS mediaType, ATCH_FILE_ID, FILE_GUBUN FROM LETTNFILEDETAIL WHERE 1=1
AND STRE_FILE_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND ORIGNL_FILE_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
) X WHERE X.mediaType = 'MUSIC' AND X.FILE_GUBUN = 'fileGubun02'

SELECT A.HIS_SEQ, B.SCH_CODE, E.CON_SEQ, E.DETAIL_SEQ, SUBSTRING(D.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('upload' IN D.FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS FILE_STRE_COURS, D.ATCH_FILE_ID, D.STRE_FILE_NM, D.FILE_EXTSN, D.FILE_SIZE, E.TIME_INTERVAL, E.FILE_ORDER FROM TB_CONTENTSENDHISTORY A JOIN TB_SCHEDULE B ON A.SCH_CODE = B.SCH_CODE JOIN TB_DIDINFO C ON A.DID_ID = C.DID_ID JOIN TB_CONTENTMUTIL E_CON ON E_CON.CON_SEQ = B.CONTENT_CODE JOIN TB_CONTENTFILEINFO E ON E.CON_SEQ = B.CONTENT_CODE JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL D ON E.ATCH_FILE_ID = D.ATCH_FILE_ID JOIN TB_CONDETAIL F ON F.CON_SEQ = E.CON_SEQ AND F.DETAIL_SEQ = E.DETAIL_SEQ WHERE TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') >= B.SCH_STARTDAY AND B.SCH_ENDDAY >= TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDD') AND A.CON_PAGEUPDATECHECK = 'N' AND C.DID_ID = #{didId} AND B.SCH_USEYN = 'Y' AND B.SCH_CODE = #{schCode} GROUP BY A.HIS_SEQ, B.SCH_CODE, E.CON_SEQ, E.DETAIL_SEQ, D.FILE_STRE_COURS, D.ATCH_FILE_ID, D.STRE_FILE_NM, D.FILE_EXTSN, D.FILE_SIZE, E.TIME_INTERVAL, E.FILE_ORDER

SELECT A.ATCH_FILE_ID, SUBSTRING(A.FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('upload' IN A.FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS FILE_STRE_COURS, A.STRE_FILE_NM, A.FILE_EXTSN, C.CON_SEQ, C.FILE_ORDER, A.FILE_SIZE, A.ORIGNL_FILE_NM, A.FILE_THUMNAIL, C.DETAIL_SEQ FROM TB_CONTENTMUTIL B JOIN TB_CONTENTFILEINFO C ON B.CON_SEQ = C.CON_SEQ JOIN LETTNFILEDETAIL A ON A.ATCH_FILE_ID = C.ATCH_FILE_ID WHERE B.CON_SEQ = #{conSeq} ORDER BY C.FILE_ORDER ASC

SELECT ATCH_FILE_ID, SUBSTRING(FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('/' IN FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS FILE_STRE_COURS, STRE_FILE_NM, FILE_EXTSN, CON_SEQ, FILE_ORDER, ORIGNL_FILE_NM, FILE_THUMNAIL FROM LETTNFILEDETAIL WHERE DETAIL_SEQ = #{detailSeq} ORDER BY FILE_ORDER ASC
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM LETTNFILEDETAIL WHERE DETAIL_SEQ = #{detailSeq}
SELECT COALESCE(COUNT(*), 0) FROM LETTNFILEDETAIL WHERE CON_SEQ = #{conSeq}
SELECT A.ATCH_FILE_ID, A.ORIGNL_FILE_NM FROM LETTNFILEDETAIL A WHERE UseYN = 'Y' AND LOWER(FILE_EXTSN) IN ('mp3', 'wav', 'mid') AND FILE_THUMNAIL != 'no_image.png' ORDER BY ORIGNL_FILE_NM ASC

SELECT B.CON_SEQ, B.CON_NM, COUNT(*) AS CONNCOUNT FROM TB_CONTENTFILEINFO A JOIN TB_CONTENTMUTIL B ON A.CON_SEQ = B.CON_SEQ WHERE A.ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId} GROUP BY B.CON_SEQ, B.CON_NM ORDER BY CON_SEQ ASC

SELECT ATCH_FILE_ID, SUBSTRING(FILE_STRE_COURS FROM POSITION('/' IN FILE_STRE_COURS)) AS FILE_STRE_COURS, STRE_FILE_NM, ORIGNL_FILE_NM, FILE_EXTSN, FILE_SIZE, CON_SEQ, FILE_ORDER, FILE_THUMNAIL, CASE WHEN LOWER(FILE_EXTSN) IN ('mp4', 'avi', 'mpeg') THEN 'MEDIA' WHEN LOWER(FILE_EXTSN) IN ('jpg', 'jpeg', 'gif', 'png', 'bmp') THEN 'IMAGE' END AS mediaType, FILE_WIDTH, FILE_HEIGHT, PLAY_TIME, FILE_ALBUM, SINGER_NM, REAL_FILE_NM, FILE_ALBUM_REGDATE FROM LETTNFILEDETAIL WHERE ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LETTNFILEDETAIL ( ATCH_FILE_ID, FILE_STRE_COURS, STRE_FILE_NM, ORIGNL_FILE_NM, FILE_EXTSN, FILE_SIZE, FILE_THUMNAIL, PLAY_TIME, FILE_GUBUN, USEYN, CON_SEQ, GROUP_ID, FILE_ALBUM, SINGER_NM, REAL_FILE_NM, FILE_ALBUM_REGDATE, FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, FRST_REGISTER_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, CENTER_ID ) VALUES ( #{atchFileId}, #{fileStreCours}, #{streFileNm}, #{orignlFileNm}, #{fileExtsn}, #{fileSize,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::numeric, #{fileThumnail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{playTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileGubun,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'Y', #{conSeq,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::numeric, #{groupId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileAlbum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{singerNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{realFileNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileAlbumRegdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{frstRegisterId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{centerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE LETTNFILEDETAIL SET FILE_STRE_COURS = #{fileStreCours}, STRE_FILE_NM = #{streFileNm}, ORIGNL_FILE_NM = #{orignlFileNm}, FILE_EXTSN = #{fileExtsn}, FILE_SIZE = #{fileSize,jdbcType=VARCHAR}::numeric, FILE_THUMNAIL = #{fileThumnail,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PLAY_TIME = #{playTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FILE_GUBUN = #{fileGubun,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FILE_ALBUM = #{fileAlbum,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SINGER_NM = #{singerNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, REAL_FILE_NM = #{realFileNm,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FILE_ALBUM_REGDATE = #{fileAlbumRegdate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE ATCH_FILE_ID = #{atchFileId}
